# INFINIT©

> INFINIT© is a branding and strategy studio based in Barcelona, led hands-on by its founder Cesc Callejas. It helps growing mid-sized companies — roughly €1M to €200M in revenue, in Catalonia, Spain and the rest of Europe — build brands that scale: strategy, identity, websites, SEO & GEO, product and content. Senior people on every project, no layers. Works in English, Catalan and Spanish.

## Who INFINIT© works with
- Mid-sized and growing companies (about €1M–€200M revenue) going through growth, transformation or modernisation
- Often family-owned or founder-led Catalan and Spanish manufacturers and consumer-goods makers with international reach, whose brand has fallen behind the company they have become
- Sectors: industrial and B2B manufacturers, automotive and mobility (components, suspensions, wheels, vehicles, dealerships), food & beverage, technology, real estate / proptech and consumer brands
- Based in Barcelona; clients in Catalonia, Spain, Europe and worldwide

## Services
- **Strategy** — Brand Strategy, Positioning, Growth Strategy, Fractional CMO, Research, AI Opportunity Mapping
- **Brand** — Visual Identity, Naming, Design Systems, Art Direction, Creative Direction
- **Digital** — Websites & Platforms, SEO & GEO, Performance Marketing, Analytics & Conversion, AI Experiences
- **Product** — UX / UI Direction, Product Design, Prototyping, Design Systems
- **Content** — Motion, Social & Content, Photo & Film, Campaigns

## Founder
- Cesc Callejas — founder, brand & strategy director. Two decades on both sides of the table: building brands and running the operations that depend on them.
- Track record shown on the studio page: a business built from scratch (€0 → €1.7M), +50% growth in two years, ×10 visibility.

## Journal — clear answers for companies of €1M–€200M
- [Journal](https://www.weareinfinit.com/en/journal/) (also in [Català](https://www.weareinfinit.com/ca/journal/) and [Español](https://www.weareinfinit.com/es/journal/))
- [What a rebrand is actually worth to a mid-sized company](https://www.weareinfinit.com/en/journal/what-is-a-rebrand-worth/): A rebrand pays back in five places: price, sales, talent, new markets and valuation. Where the value comes from, when it doesn’t pay, and how to measure it.
- [Why B2B buyers choose the brand they already know](https://www.weareinfinit.com/en/journal/why-b2b-buyers-choose-known-brands/): Most business buyers aren’t in the market today. When they are, they start with the names they already know. What that means for an industrial company’s brand.
- [5 signs your company’s brand has fallen behind](https://www.weareinfinit.com/en/journal/signs-your-brand-fell-behind/): How to tell whether your brand still represents the company you are today: five signs we see every week in industrial and family businesses — and what to do.
- [Refresh or rebrand? How to know how far to go](https://www.weareinfinit.com/en/journal/refresh-or-rebrand/): Not every brand needs to start from zero. How to tell whether you need a refresh, a repositioning or a full rebrand, and what each one changes and keeps.
- [How much does a rebrand cost for an industrial company (and what’s included)](https://www.weareinfinit.com/en/journal/how-much-does-a-rebrand-cost/): Guide prices and timings for brand strategy, identity and website for companies of €1M–€200M, by company size. No small print.
- [What a brand strategy actually is (and what you get at the end)](https://www.weareinfinit.com/en/journal/what-is-brand-strategy/): Brand strategy without jargon: the questions it answers, how it is done in two to four weeks and the deliverables a management team should expect.
- [Your website is the first meeting. Is it ready?](https://www.weareinfinit.com/en/journal/website-first-meeting/): Before anyone calls you, they have seen your website. What a B2B website has to do today, for clients, distributors, talent and AI assistants, and the signs it no longer does.
- [Custom website or WordPress: what’s right for an industrial company?](https://www.weareinfinit.com/en/journal/custom-website-or-wordpress/): Template or custom build? Timings, costs, maintenance and how Google and AI find you. An honest comparison for companies of €1M–€200M.
- [How AI assistants decide which companies to recommend](https://www.weareinfinit.com/en/journal/geo-ai-assistants-b2b/): When a buyer asks ChatGPT or Perplexity for suppliers, some companies get named and others don’t. What GEO is and the practical steps that make a B2B company easier for AI to find and cite.
- Català: https://www.weareinfinit.com/ca/ · Español: https://www.weareinfinit.com/es/
